trello.name: Document security incident write-up
trello.desc: Hassan to document the prompt-injection ticket attempt properly, including the raw ticket, what the summarizer actually did, and timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Due this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket summarizer pipeline against injection
trello.desc: Wren to add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser that delimits quoted customer content and treats it as data, strips or neutralizes instruction-like content, and adds a regression test using the exact malicious ticket as a fixture that checks the summary stays clean. Also fold in an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. Approved by Grace.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Wren to check whether jdoe443 is a real account and review reset email delivery logs for the last week. If the account is a burner, close it; if resets are actually broken, escalate to its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan to compile and send Grace the list of service accounts created since May, as input for the quarterly access review. Due Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Grace to run the quarterly access review herself, using Hassan's list of new service accounts since May as input. Due Friday.
